description: Daily global mean air temperature at 2 metres since 1 January 1940 from the ERA5 reanalysis, as the difference from the 1991–2020 average for the same day of the year. The newest days are preliminary.

processing.description: Read the Climate Pulse daily series of global 2 m air temperature from ERA5, last updated by C3S on 05 October 2026, from 1940-01-01 to 2026-10-03.
Published the producer's anomaly from its smoothed 1991–2020 daily climatology (column ano_91-20) unchanged, rounded as printed (three decimals).

Kept the file's status of each day: 1 day(s) marked PRELIMINARY are published as preliminary, because the file states that their values will likely change slightly once the final ERA5 data for the day are available.

scope.baseline: 1991–2020 daily climatology of this dataset, smoothed by C3S
scope.basis: ERA5 reanalysis; daily mean of hourly 2 m air temperature from 00 to 23 UTC.

title: Global air temperature against 1991–2020, daily (ERA5 Climate Pulse)
